articles.headline: Rueben Chinyelu comes up big and No. 3 Florida escapes with a 76-67 win against Milwaukee
articles.description: — Rueben Chinyelu posted his first double-double of the season and made the first 3-pointer of his college career as No. 3 Florida escaped with a 76-67 victory against Milwaukee on Tuesday night.

articles.headline: Colorado rallies from 20-point deficit, beats Stanford 70-65 at Acrisure Series
articles.description: — Barrington Hargress had 19 points on 7-of-8 shooting, Justin Neely scored 16 and Colorado overcame a 20-point deficit and beat Stanford 70-65 on Tuesday night at the Acrisure Series.

articles.headline: No. 22 Gonzaga routs Kansas State 101-61 in Players Era 16 first round
articles.description: — Massamba Diop scored 18 points and grabbed seven rebounds as No. 22 Gonzaga routed Kansas State 101-61 on Tuesday night in the opening round of the Players Era 16 tournament.

images.name: Gonzaga Bulldogs vs. Kansas State Wildcats: Game Highlights
images.caption: Gonzaga Bulldogs vs. Kansas State Wildcats: Game Highlights

articles.headline: Louisville's Kelsey tells 5th-year critics 'bring it' as Trimble shines in upset
articles.description: After Seth Trimble led Louisville to a 72-64 win over No. 5 Texas Tech, Cardinals coach Pat Kelsey told critics of teams using fifth-year players, "Everybody can have their opinion. Bring it."

images.name: Seth Trimble [600x400]
images.caption: Seth Trimble scored 24 points in Tuesday's win over No. 5 Texas Tech that gave Louisville its first victory over an AP top-five opponent under coach Pat Kelsey.

images.name: Seth Trimble's late 3 helps No. 25 Louisville upset No. 5 Texas Tech

articles.headline: No. 13 St. John's beats Oregon 90-79 in opening round of Players Era 16 tournament
articles.description: — Ian Jackson scored 21 points as part of a balanced effort by No. 13 St. John's, which beat Oregon 90-79 on Tuesday night in the opening round of the Players Era 16 tournament.
